task: fuzz driver save/replay and bounded CBZ extraction
root_cause: The saved CBZ mutation had a central-directory compressed size (71) smaller than the local-header size (77). mz_zip_reader_extract_iter_read used the central size, fed tinfl a truncated deflate stream, and looped without copying or consuming further input.
fix: src/cbz.c reads the local file header for member data offset and sizes (central only for data descriptors), and inflates with a bounded tinfl_decompress loop using TINFL_FLAG_USING_NON_WRAPPING_OUTPUT_BUF; each round must consume input or produce output, output is capped at 1 MiB for headers / 32 MiB for members, and full members are CRC checked.
pending: CI sanitizer run and POSIX truncation path verification after push
